Name: KivoValley KuroFuku(Krobus) HD Portraits
Author: Trans1st0r
Description:
你好，谢谢您的点击，也许也谢谢您的下载。我是中国星露谷爱好者，b站和p站都叫风吟梧桦！

该mod[color=#00ffff]暂时只有人像部分[/color]：mod前置为肖像，请在安装了Portraiture以后将下载得到的压缩包直接解压到Stardew Valley/Mods文件夹中，会自动在Stardew Valley /Mods/Portraiture/Portraits创建中KivoValley文件夹（和美游肖像是一个系列，共存）后，进存档与任何人交谈，按“M”键选中“KivoValley”包。

[color=#00ff00]我暂未绘制sprites，小黑已经很可爱了！[/color]

该Mod将作为一个系列逐渐出现，敬请期待！
所有肖像资源归作者所有

***** XD *****

English Translation:

[color=#e06666]I know it's weird, but.. She looks quite cute when she smiles...[/color]

This mod[color=#00ffff] currently only includes the portrait part,[/color] requires Portraiture as a prerequisite. Install and unzip the downloaded package directly into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder. It will automatically create a "KivoValley" folder within "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" (which coexists with the Miyu portraits as part of a series). Afterwards, enter any save and talk to anyone, then press the "M" key to select the "KivoValley" pack.

[color=#00ff00]I haven't drawn sprites yet, as vanilla Krobus is already very cute![/color]

This Mod will gradually appear as a series, so stay tuned!All portrait resources are owned by the author.
